scenes.title: £1,319 a month from a 1-bed Airbnb in Jamaica
scenes.vo: One thousand three hundred and nineteen pounds a month. That's what a typical one-bed Airbnb in Jamaica makes, gross, at sixty percent occupancy.
It's based on a typical nightly rate of seventy-two pounds, about ninety-seven US dollars, across over two and a half thousand live one-beds.
One-beds are almost half of all the short-term rentals we track, so expect plenty of competition.

scenes.desc: Typical asking price, 1-bed home in Jamaica
scenes.vo: And a typical one-bed is listed at about a hundred and seventy thousand pounds, or two hundred and twenty-seven thousand US dollars.
Remember, that's before cleaning, platform fees and management.
